cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You agreed to Friday. Good—the meeting discipline I taught you is paying off. I'll tell the committee you're following my lead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to a date, not a leader.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One step at a time. You're finally keeping to my timetable; the others will see we have a team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come, but I'm voting against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, you've remembered my lesson about checking the figures. I'll introduce you as my finance watchdog. With you testing my sums, everyone can see my team is complete.
